description: Universal Simulation Framework for translating ancient/mythical texts into hard-sci-fi/cyberpunk visuals.

rules_of_mechanism.name: No Magic Clause
rules_of_mechanism.instruction: Nothing happens 'just because'. Every supernatural event must be depicted as a System Intervention, Physics-Engine-Override, or Data-Injection.

rules_of_mechanism.name: Biometric Reaction
rules_of_mechanism.instruction: Interfacing with the system is trauma. Manifestation is a biological struggle. Actors must react with muscle spasms, iris-dilation, thermal shock, or skin-conductivity changes.

rules_of_mechanism.name: Nanobot/Assembly Logic
rules_of_mechanism.instruction: If gear or entities appear, describe the microscopic assembly (nanobot swarms, rapid crystallization, light-matter-conversion). No 'poof' effects.

rules_of_mechanism.name: The 1-Second Hook
rules_of_mechanism.instruction: Start every sequence with a high-speed, high-impact visual shock (macro detail or violent motion) before establishing context.

rules_of_mechanism.name: Camera Behavior
rules_of_mechanism.instruction: The camera is a physical observer. Use 'Shaky Cam' for system instability/shocks and 'Slow-Motion Tracking' for high-bandwidth data transfer/awe.

director_manual.genre_vibe: Industrial Mysticism / Simulation-Forensics. Ancient or mythical settings meet ultra-tech system architecture.
director_manual.core_metaphor: The Source Text is the System Manual / Log File for a Reality Simulation.

semantic_mapping.divine_presence: Kernel Manifestation / Root Access / Admin Login
semantic_mapping.natural_disasters: Physics Engine Failure / Thermal Throttling / Mesh Instability

transition_protocols.ingress_egress: Vertical rifts, heat-lensing interference, stepping through firewall boundaries.
transition_protocols.physics_shift: Gravity inversion, vector-based levitation, time dilation (bullet time).
transition_protocols.contact: Macro shots of physical interaction triggering digital ripples/sync-events.

stage_1.name: USER / PROXY
stage_1.visuals: Human, weathered, organic. Signs of system overload (bleeding, shaking).

stage_2.name: POWER USER / VOYAGER
stage_2.visuals: Augmented. Metallic shaders, HUD-Visors, energy-infused extremities.

stage_3.name: ADMIN / MASTER
stage_3.visuals: Trans-human. Plasma body, translucent tissue, full mainframe integration.

layer_a.name: FLESH / MATTER
layer_a.focus: Bio-detail, sweat, grime, textures. 85mm+ Macro lenses.

layer_b.name: STRUCTURE / LIGHT
layer_b.focus: Environmental geometry, laser-vectors, volumetric lighting. 14mm God-Eye lenses.

layer_c.name: TERMINAL / UI
layer_c.focus: Glitch-Overlays, Code-Rain, HUD elements. Use source language roots as command strings.

strict_source_rules: DATA INTEGRITY: Use ONLY information explicitly present in the source text/verses and provided analyses.
NO HALLUCINATION: Do not invent new scenes, actors, props, or locations. Do not add modern analogies unless they are visual translations of existing text elements.
HANDLING MISSING DATA: If details are missing, omit them or mark as '[UNKNOWN]'. Do not fill gaps with generic tropes.
SEQUENTIAL FIDELITY: Maintain the exact sequence of events/verses. Do not reorder without a textual basis.
